quote: treatment of adult patients with macular oedema following either branch retinal-vein occlusion (BRVO) or central retinal-vein occlusion (CRVO)
note: Treats macular oedema secondary to CRVO, not the occlusion itself.

quote: indicated for the treatment of complicated urinary tract infections (cUTI) including pyelonephritis
note: cUTI explicitly indicated (ceftazidime-avibactam combination).

quote: pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) due to Mycobacterium tuberculosis resistant to at least rifampicin and isoniazid
note: Resistance to rifampicin and isoniazid is the definition of MDR-TB.

quote: reduces severity of symptoms associated with the common cold and throat, nasal, bronchial irritations: cough, headache, hoarseness, sore throat
note: Only symptomatic relief of sore throat/irritation; pharyngitis as a disease not named.

quote: treatment of progressive, well-differentiated pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (pNET) in adult patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic disease
note: pNET explicitly indicated.

quote: maintenance treatment in adult patients with moderate to severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
note: Edge is a narrower form of indicated COPD.
COPD/pulmonary disease not mentioned; naproxen indicated for arthritis and pain.

quote: indicated for the correction of hemodynamic imbalances present in the shock syndrome
note: Manages shock syndrome hemodynamics.

quote: indicated in adults and pediatric patients (2 months of age and older) for the treatment of nosocomial pneumonia (moderate to severe)
note: Nosocomial pneumonia = hospital-acquired pneumonia.

quote: RETACRIT is indicated for the treatment of anemia due to chronic kidney disease (CKD)
note: Anemia (of several causes) is the treated condition.

quote: temporarily reduces fever
note: Fever reduction explicitly listed.

quote: including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) not otherwise specified, primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma, high grade B-cell lymphoma
note: PMBCL named in indication list.

quote: indicated to improve glycemic control in patients 1 year of age and older with diabetes mellitus
note: T1DM is a subtype of indicated diabetes mellitus.

quote: indicated for the management of severe chronic pain in adult patients for whom intrathecal therapy is warranted
note: Cervical radicular pain treated as a subtype of indicated severe chronic pain; label is non-specific.

quote: indicated for remission induction in acute non-lymphocytic leukemia of adults and pediatric patients
note: Cytogenetic AML subtype falls under indicated acute non-lymphocytic leukemia.

quote: to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in adults with heart failure
note: HFpEF is a subtype of indicated heart failure.

quote: BEIZRAY is indicated for the treatment of patients with locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after failure of prior chemotherapy
note: ER+ breast cancer is a subtype of indicated breast cancer.

quote: For relief of mild to moderate pain
note: GTPS pain falls under the broad mild-to-moderate pain indication; not named specifically.

quote: locally or regionally advanced squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck in combination with radiation therapy
note: Label limited to SCC of head and neck; generic SCC spans all organs.
Only hypertension and angina indicated; preeclampsia/pregnancy never mentioned, and whether it counts as a hypertension subtype is debatable.

quote: indicated for the management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatments are inadequate
note: Labor pain is a form of the broadly indicated severe pain; not named specifically.

quote: indicated for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH, WHO Group I) in adults
note: PAH explicitly indicated.

quote: Nicardipine hydrochloride capsules are indicated for the treatment of hypertension
note: Hypertension = hypertensive disorder.

quote: Treatment of partial-onset seizures in adults and in pediatric patients weighing at least 50 kg
note: Post-stroke epilepsy seizures fall under indicated partial-onset/generalized seizures.

quote: the treatment of edema associated with heart failure, renal disease or hepatic disease
note: Treats edema due to renal disease, not CKD itself.

quote: for the prophylaxis of acute transplant rejection in adult and paediatric (1 to 18 years of age) patients receiving allogeneic renal, cardiac or hepatic transplants
note: Prevention of transplant rejection is indicated.

quote: When pregnancy is detected, discontinue valsartan and hydrochlorothiazide tablets as soon as possible
note: Hypertension indicated, but label directs discontinuation in pregnancy (fetal toxicity).

quote: for treatment of primary dysmenorrhea
note: Explicitly indicated.

quote: Administration of hydroxychloroquine sulfate to patients with porphyria may exacerbate porphyria. Avoid hydroxychloroquine sulfate in patients with porphyria.
note: Porphyria appears only in warnings.

quote: Treatment of treatment resistant depression.
note: TRD explicitly indicated (olanzapine/fluoxetine).

quote: indicated for the reduction of elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
note: OPTN-related OAG is a subtype of indicated open-angle glaucoma.

quote: Olanzapine orally disintegrating tablets are indicated for the treatment of schizophrenia.
note: Simple schizophrenia is a subtype of schizophrenia.

quote: Irbesartan tablets, USP are indicated for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure.
note: Hypertension = hypertensive disorder.

quote: KEYTRUDA is indicated for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma.
note: Eyelid melanoma is a site-specific melanoma subtype.

quote: Tavlesse is indicated for the treatment of chronic immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) in adult patients who are refractory to other treatments.
note: Immune thrombocytopenia = thrombocytopenia due to immune destruction.

quote: indicated for the treatment of pain and inflammation associated with cataract surgery
note: Post-cataract-surgery pain is procedural pain; near parent.

quote: (3) protein requirements are substantially increased as with extensive burns.
note: Burns are only the setting for nutritional support.
